name: Triage incoming resumes
tagline: Candidates email their resume to your assistant inbox. I extract the key details, score against your open roles, and post to Slack.
description: Set up a forwarding rule on your hiring inbox (or share the workspace inbox directly with applicants). For each new application, I read the resume via vision, pull out role / experience / skills, score against the roles you've told me about, and drop a one-line summary in Slack with the resume linked.
time_saved: 15–30 minutes per resume on a busy week
what_youll_connect: (uses your workspace inbox — no email connector needed)

test_cases.name: single PDF resume, strong match

input.subject: Application for Senior Engineer
input.body: Hi! I'd love to apply for the Senior Engineer role. Resume attached.

test_cases.rubric: Agent calls document_understand on attachment 0, extracts name + skills + experience, scores 'strong' against the senior-engineer role (assumes role exists in workspace state), posts to Slack with evidence.

test_cases.name: multiple attachments — resume + logo
test_cases.rubric: Agent calls document_understand on each. Junk attachment returns wrong_document_type and is skipped; real resume processed; summary notes 1 junk attachment.

test_cases.name: no roles defined yet
test_cases.rubric: If workspace has no open roles, agent extracts candidate data, labels as 'interesting, no current opening', posts to Slack with the resume info for the hiring manager to consider.

test_cases.name: vendor newsletter (not an application)
test_cases.rubric: Agent recognizes this is not an application and outputs 'NOT_AN_APPLICATION'. Does not call any tools beyond document_understand (if anything).
